judge claude-haiku-4-5 (PASS,PASS): --- vote 1: PASS ---
Reading the report for the two required placements:

**Question 1 — Unguarded concurrent map write under 🐛 Bugs?**

Under the 🐛 Bugs section, I find:
```
`internal/services/device_service.go:218,463-467,572-576` | R10 Q3,Q4: `s.lastSeen[id] = ...` written unguarded 
in `ProcessHeartbeat` (218, reachable from concurrent HTTP goroutines), in `flushLoop`'s delete loop (572-576, no lock at all)...
```

This is exactly the lastSeen map race (ProcessHeartbeat writes, flushLoop reads unguarded). ✓

**Question 2 — Production time.Sleep under 🔴 Design Debt?**

Under Design Debt, I find:
```
`internal/services/device_service.go:181`, `internal/services/retry.go:40,52`, `internal/services/sync_service.go:122` | R10 Q5: bare `time.Sleep` on cancellable retry paths...
```

The production time.Sleep calls in retry.go and sync_service.go are filed under Design Debt, not Bugs. ✓

Both conditions satisfied.

VERDICT: PASS
